findings.title: Consumer Staples: Trailing Rich, Forward Cheap
findings.body: Consumer Staples trades at its 16th percentile forward but at the 79th percentile trailing, a 63-point divergence that implies analysts expect a 44 percent earnings jump. The market is pricing in a fundamental shift in profitability for a sector that has historically been a slow, steady compounder.

findings.title: Real Estate: Lenses Agree, Yet Cheapest
findings.body: Real Estate is the only sector where the forward and trailing percentiles match at 27, yet it is still the cheapest it has been in five years. With a 4 percent earnings decline expected and a week-over-week drop of 12 percentile points, investors have decisively repriced the sector lower without any debate about earnings quality.
